svg.title: J1 — On-call responder: from page to closed ticket without leaving Slack
svg.desc: One incident, one Slack thread. The responder reads, decides, approves. Smokejumper witnesses, reasons, files, and proves. Times are the design target for a high-severity alert.
svg.text: J1 — On-call responder: from page to closed ticket without leaving Slack
One incident, one Slack thread. The responder reads, decides, approves. Smokejumper witnesses, reasons, files, and proves. Times are the design target for a high-severity alert.
B5 token bound to tool call sha
What the responder never does: open Grafana, grep logs, find the deploy, or write the ticket. What the responder always does: read three citations and press one button.

Every card in lanes 3–5 is one or more B8 lines; ‘View steps’ opens the full ledger (see system/c3-components.svg, step ledger). Cards in lane 2 are the ONLY Slack posts — one root card edited in place plus four thread replies.
Design targets, not measurements: t+3m to a cited conclusion on a high-severity alert; t+6m mitigated when a reversible action exists and a human approves.
